caseName: White Star Mining Co. v. Hultberg
caseNameFull: White Star Mining Company, in Error v. Nels O. Hultberg Claes W. Johnson, in Error v. White Star Mining Company of Illinois and Peter H. Anderson, in Error v. White Star Mining Company of Illinois
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Illinois.
attorneys: Mr. Harris F. Williams, Mr. Frederick S. Winston, Mr. John Barton Payne and Mr. Silas H. Stravm in support of motion to dismiss. Mr. Charles H. Hamill and Mr. Carl R. Chindblom in opposition thereto.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Sayward v. Denny, 158 U. S. 180; San Francisco v. Scott, 111 U. S. 769; Delmas v. Insurance Company, 14 Wall. 661; Erie Railroad Company v. Purdy, 185 U. S. 148; Oxley Stave Company v. Butler County, 166 U. S. 648. Case below, 220 Illinois, 578.
